  • SymPy 1.14.0: polynomial reference. Definitions tested groebnermethods f5b/buchberger, is_zero_dimensional and fglm. FGLM It is applied to the null-dimensional ideal. The working code uses F5B, independent auditing Buchberger.
  • Keegan Ryan, Solving Multivariate Coppersmith Problems with Known Moduli, ePrint 2024/1577. Read the page with annotation: the work discusses the choice of polynomial Disruption of small solutions for modular systems and compromise with the size of the grid. PDF by the link of the protocol returned HTTP 403. The specific algorithms of the article were not reproduced; it serves as a context It's not a justification for the completeness of the shift system chosen here.

Conditionalities H < N Explained directly: an entire linear combination generators are a multiplicity of N on the permissible root; its absolute limiting H. Single multiple N open-space (-N,N) That's a sufficient condition; the opposite is not stated.

Domestic sources: adopted SEQ-06, SEQ-07 and SEQ-08. Copies of them Supportive implementations have been verified by SHA256. Old search stages The old control inputs are not included in the new sample.
